name: Alif, as the studio builds it: the stem, narrowing to its foot; the head, a diamond pull; the flag, a wedge off the head's edge
Meem, standalone, as the studio builds it: three pieces from one point at the head's left, the arch over the top, the band under it, and the long tail tapering to a hair
Ya/ba tooth, starting, stacked: the descent from inside its head onto the next letter; the head, a diamond pull; the hat, a wedge off the head's edge (studio reference)
Meem, middle, under a stacked tooth: the pen comes in round the loop; the band over the top and out to the left is a piece of its own, and the pen leaves by it (studio reference)
Nun, finishing, as the studio builds it: the arm from its beak, the bowl tucked under the arm's foot, and the knot where the incoming stroke meets the arm
Hamza: the head curled round from its top, turned sharply into the tail; book plate 23, at that plate's pen
Alif, joining a lam after it (the studio's الحب): one sweep from below the line up to the lam's top (studio reference)
Lam, starting: the stem down from its top; the foot a piece of its own, which the pen leaves by (studio reference)
Ha, middle: the flat head written left to right; the band back down into the next letter, which the pen leaves by (studio reference)
Ba, finishing: the turned-up start, then the boat to a thin tip (studio reference)
Ha, starting: the head written left to right from its hook; the band back down, which the pen leaves by (studio reference)
Ya, middle: up to its tooth, then down into the next letter, which the pen leaves by (studio reference)
Alif, finishing: from the join on the line up to its top (studio reference)
Ta, starting: the tooth's head (two short pulls), the descent, and the band out to the left, which the pen leaves by (studio reference)
Ya, finishing: in from the right, then round its bowl to a thin tip (the studio writes it without dots) (studio reference)
